original.description: Authentic Red Sea Global master logo: gold flowing-lines circular emblem + navy 'Red Sea Global' serif wordmark.

white_variant.description: Dark-background variant. Tasklet-derived from the original by recoloring the navy wordmark to white while preserving the gold emblem unchanged. For use on navy/cinematic cover and closing slides.

notes: White variant is a color-only derivative of the official RSG logo (no reshaping of marks). Used on RSG x Navier deck cover + co-branded closing. If RSG supplies an official reversed/white brand asset, replace the derived variant.
